answer: Twelve bridge probes send a signed ping to every seat each epoch and keep its fastest round trip per probe. A seat votes only after a 30-epoch horizon of pings. Light sets a floor: delay can be added but never removed. A seat is shadowed by an older seat if its fastest time to every probe is within 1 ms of that seat's or slower. The k-th seat shadowing one origin locks k² copper. A newcomer locks 1 copper. Thirty clones on one rack, padded or not, lock 9,455 copper, unless each leases a host in a different city.
